paragraphs: ST Engineering Telematics Wireless sells outdoor lighting control systems and energy and water resource management solutions carried on RF wireless networks. The water line is sold as BrightCity Smart Water AMI, for smart water meter monitoring and control at large scale. The water product is offered to water utilities, municipalities and cities, for both brownfield and greenfield sites.

Connected street lighting brings together smart luminaires, smart control and centralized management to deliver energy savings for public lighting. A Lighting Control Unit enables control at segment level and lamp level, and the T-Light Galaxy Base Station is a gateway installed inside a building and connected to the high antenna for wide area coverage. The central management system automates, schedules and provides real-time control of street lighting, and enables predictive maintenance.

One case study covers 250,000 standalone water meters turned into smart communicating devices across Singapore. Another covers the city of Auckland, where 121,000 streetlights were connected and 39 GWh per annum of energy savings were generated.

quote.text: They support cities, communities and industries, ensuring round-the-clock operational intelligence, monitoring and control and precision data about utilities operations.
